title: Triage baseline frontend development-tool dependency advisories
description: Baseline npm audit reported seven high-severity advisories through the shadcn development-tool dependency chain, rooted in braces deeply nested pattern stack exhaustion (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm). Determine the applicable fix without an automatic breaking CLI downgrade or force upgrade.
acceptance_criteria: Given the pinned frontend dependency tree, when audit and dependency reachability are inspected, then affected development and production paths are recorded from actual output.

Given an available compatible remediation, when applied in a separate change, then lockfile/check/build and relevant component-generation behavior remain valid; otherwise record the unresolved upstream constraint.
test_cases: npm audit --json; npm ls braces micromatch fast-glob shadcn; frontend check/build after any dependency change.
verification: October8 baseline audit metadata: seven high, zero critical. Affected chain includes braces, micromatch, fast-glob, @shadcn/registry, @ts-morph/common, ts-morph and direct development dependency shadcn4.21.4. Audit suggested shadcn1.0.0 as a semver-major fix; no force upgrade/downgrade applied. Runtime exploitability and a compatible remediation have not yet been established. Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm.
